decision_conditions: For the purposes of this decision, conditions D/O2, D2 and D3 of planning permission 20/04187/OUT shall be replaced with the following condition wording: Replacement Condition D/O2. CIL Phasing(a) This planning permission is a 'Phased planning permission' for the purposes of the CIL Regulations (as amended); which expressly provides for the approved development to be implemented in phases. Phase 1 and Phases 2 to 4 shall be treated as a separate 'phase' and as separate chargeable development for the purposes of the CIL Regulations.(b) Phase 1: consists of mixed-use buildings providing ground floor flexible commercial use floorspace (Use Class E), residential units (Use Class C3), community club (Use Class F2) infrastructure landscaped amenity space, car parking, cycle parking and associated works as identified on approved Parameter Plan A: GA Masterplan Block Plan (1106_M_P0101_A) and indicative GA Masterplan Phasing Plan (1106_M_P0121_A); and (c) Phases 2 to 4: consist of separate phases of flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class E), bars/drinking establishments, hot food takeaways and leisure uses (Use Class Sui Generis), covered market (Use Class E), community and leisure (Use Classes F1, F2, and Sui Generis) ,residential floorspace and the remodelling of existing residential entrance space for Grampian, Mendip and Pennine Houses (Use Class C3), associated infrastructure; streets, open spaces, landscaping and public realm; car, motorcycle and bicycle parking spaces and delivery/servicing spaces; utilities including electricity substations; and other works incidental to the proposed development as identifiedon approved Parameter Plan A: GA Masterplan Block Plan (1106_M_P0101_A) and indicative GA Masterplan Phasing Plan 1106_M_P0121_A).REASON: In order that this planning permission qualifies as a Phased planning permission for the purposes of the Community Infrastructure Levy Regulations 2010 (as amended) and to provide clarity on the extent of the 'Phases'. Replacement Condition D2. Approved DrawingsThe Development of the Detailed element of the permission hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved drawings:Location Plan - 1106_PH1_X0001, Existing Plan - 1106_PH1_P1101_A, 1106_PH1_P1102_A, 1106_PH1_P1103_A, 1106_PH1_P1104_A, 1106_PH1_P1105_A, 1106_PH1_P1106_A, 1106_PH1_P1107_A, 1106_PH1_P1108_A, 1106_PH1_P1109, 1106_PH1_P1110, 1106_PH1_P1111, 1106_PH1_P1112, 1106_PH1_P1113, 1106_PH1_P1114, 1106_PH1_P1115, 1106B AF P0202 Rev E, 1106 PH1_P0101 Rev D, 1106 PH1_P0221 Rev CThe Detailed element of the permission hereby approved, as depicted on the approved drawings, shall be completed in accordance with the approved drawings, except where conditions attached to this planning permission or S106 obligations related to this planning permission indicate otherwise.REASON: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.Replacement Condition D3. Opening hours(a)	Any café/restaurant (Use Class E(b)) premises shall not be open to the public outside of the following times 07.00 to 24.00 Monday to Saturday and between 08.00 and 23.00 hours on Sundays and Bank Holidays.(b)	Any community club (Use Class F2) premises shall not be in use outside of the following times 09.00 to 23.00 Monday to Saturday and between 09.00 and 23.00 hours on Sundays and Bank Holidays.(c) Any café/restaurant (Use Class E(b)) or community club (Use Class F2) premises shall not be open at any other time and all activity associated with the use shall cease within 1 hour of the closing time specified above.REASON: To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring residential occupiers.
